checks.evidence: Projection and fallback execution prohibited. pilot.py:1894 transforms bounds with pyproj; :2278 reads the T1-03 extent. io.py:1733 constructs the projection from label fields. pyproj is declared in pipeline/pyproject.toml and locked in uv.lock; .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pyproj-3.8.0.dist-info/METADATA states version 3.8.0. checks.evidence: Numerical recomputation prohibited. checks.criterion: AC5: Raw Stokes observations when paired layers cover Site01, with no sign verdict or added validity threshold
checks.evidence: The required Stokes-present execution could not be run. pilot.py:2257 pairs covering S1/S4 layers, :2159 reads them sequentially, and :3098 computes raw joint-mask statistics without a sign flip, physical-validity count, or minimum count. Tests at test_pilot_minirf.py:1037, :1068 and :1155 exercise these paths. The real inventory contains only CPR/S1; outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:880 records not_performed and :754 lists the MAP-V1.0 single-swath open item.

checks.evidence: Checksum recomputation and error-path execution prohibited. pilot.py:2418 creates records for every fetched label and :2446 creates records for retained image rows; :331 sorts upserts by product_id. outputs/sources.json contains 24 Mini-RF label records and one CPR rows record. pilot.py:520 returns nonzero with the error; test_pilot_minirf.py:663 checks the unreachable URL.
